item.title: Delays after vehicle on fire blocks busy road
item.description: Drivers are currently facing delays after a vehicle fire broke out on the A11 at Besthorpe.

item.title: Environmental game changers shortlisted at East Anglia Clean & Green Awards
item.description: Three businesses have been named as finalists for the Game Changer of the Year award, sponsored by Cadeler, at the East Anglia Clean & Green Awards 2026.

item.title: New cheese experience helps curious customers explore new flavours
item.description: The Norfolk Deli has launched The Cheesemonger’s Selection, a curated cheese board service, designed to take the guesswork out of cheese discovery.

item.title: Man caught by paedophile hunters after trying to make sexual remarks to schoolgirls
item.description: A Hungarian national living in Norwich was caught by a paedophile hunter group as he tried to make sexual remarks to schoolgirls.

item.title: New traffic schemes for 99 roads in Norfolk towns and villages to slow down drivers
item.description: Almost a hundred roads in Norfolk towns and villages are to be made safer, with new speed limit signs and traffic calming.

item.title: Bridge repairs to force road to shut for two days
item.description: Hargham Road in Quidenham, near Thetford, is to close for two days while bridge repair works are completed.
